title: A 'we are down' page that appears by itself
about: Sooner or later a website's server breaks or is being updated. Without preparation, visitors see a scary browser error. Here a spare page steps in automatically and tells them politely to come back later.
tryThis: Stop fb-main and refresh the site on port 8003: you see the spare page. Start it again and the real site returns.

roles.fb-front: The front door. It uses the real site when it can and the spare page only when it cannot.
roles.fb-main: The real website that visitors normally see.
roles.fb-fallback: The spare page. It waits quietly and only shows when the real site is down.
